paragraphs.en: The coast relay has a damaged inspection drone beside its outgoing lead. Approach it from the existing control stand after the rescued people are registered under shelter and the short-range request has been sent. The technician deals with this local defence alone. Lina remains with the sheltered group; her earlier rescue cooperation does not place a second copy of her at the relay. No recruited companion or free harbour assistance is required here. Reading this notice does not stop the drone or send a signal.
paragraphs.zh: 海岸中继出线旁有一架故障巡检浮机。救援人员登记入棚并由短距设备送出请求后，在既有控制台处理。此次地方防卫由检修人独自执行；莉娜仍与棚内救援组在一起，不把先前协作复制到中继。不要求招募同伴或港口援勤。读说明不会停浮机或发信号。

paragraphs.en: The drone has 100 stopping progress, no equipment reduction, and a stability threshold of three. It alternates a declared single-person strike of 24 raw units with a preparation slot that does not attack. These are new numerical candidates for the registered two-level relay defence, awaiting actual balance review. Once the threat is controlled, switch the independent transmitter off, seat the displaced lead, restore its own reserve and test that exact configuration. The defence result does not perform those repairs, collect the recorder or mail, certify a distant tower, locate the mentor, or award experience. Withdrawing restores this encounter entry and its carried supplies without erasing already acquired notes.
paragraphs.zh: 浮机候选制止进度100、装备减伤0、稳定阈3；公开单体24原始冲击与不攻击的准备槽轮替。这是既登记2级中继防卫的新增数值候选，实际平衡人审待完成。制止后仍须隔离独立发送器、接线、恢复本地储备和检验当前配置。防卫不代修复、取记录或邮包，不认证远塔/导师位置，不奖经验。撤回恢复本遭遇入口与携带补给，已得笔记不抹除。

paragraphs.en: Two local approaches lead from this tower base to the same existing control-level entrance. The side gate is an alternative to the outer gate, not a second tower or an extra reward. Obtain the current Tidegate work permission and inspect its actual local supply before choosing an approach. At the marked side stand, switch the gate drive off and isolate it, secure the movable brace, then verify zero energy and zero motion. Isolation is required before the brace is touched. A note, a pressure effect or an early inspection cannot supply the missing physical steps.
paragraphs.zh: 塔基两条地方处置都通往原有控制层入口。侧闸是外闸替代，不是另一座塔或额外奖励。先取当前潮门现场许可并检查实际本地供给。在侧闸站位依次关闭隔离驱动、固定活动支架、核验零能和零运动；碰支架前必须隔离。笔记、压力效果或提前检查不能补未操作步骤。

paragraphs.en: Instead of the complete manual procedure, this side gate offers a separate shared-combat approach against its inspection drone. The candidate drone has 160 stopping progress, eight percent equipment reduction and a stability threshold of three. Its declared 36-unit single-person strike alternates with a non-attacking preparation slot. The actual hero and two currently lawful helpers use their own equipment; the formal recruitment of Lina is optional. Either a complete manual record or a controlled drone can establish side access. Once one tower-base approach has been received, the other is not opened for repeated results. This local gate result does not close cooling valves, isolate the tower unit, verify tower safety, transfer Glimmer, or award experience.
paragraphs.zh: 侧闸除完整手动规程，也有独立共享战斗浮机处置：制止进度160、装备减伤8%、稳定阈3，公开单体36冲击与不攻击准备槽轮替。真实主角与两个当前合法援助使用自己的装备；正式招募莉娜可选。完整手动记录或制止浮机均可建立侧闸通行。一个塔基入口受理后，不开放另一入口刷结果。闸门结果不关闭冷却阀、不隔离塔主机、不验塔安全、不移交微光号、不奖经验。

paragraphs.en: The outer approach has a braced guard protecting a rear inspection drone. Its declared strike and column sweep give time to choose positions, guard, apply pressure or use the party's existing actions. The front guard has 190 stopping progress, fifteen percent equipment reduction and stability threshold five; its raw strike is 38 and its column sweep is 26 per target. The rear drone has 85 progress, no equipment reduction and threshold three; its 18-unit strike alternates with a non-attacking preparation slot. These finite values and this two-enemy group are new unreviewed candidates, not claims of a calibrated playtime.
paragraphs.zh: 外闸固守机卫保护后排巡检浮机。公开单体冲击与列扫掠允许选择站位、防御、压力或现有队伍动作。前机卫制止进度190、装备减伤15%、阈5，原始单击38与每目标列扫26；后浮机进度85、减伤0、阈3，单击18和不攻击准备槽轮替。这些固定值与双敌编组是新增未审候选，不声称已校准游玩时长。

paragraphs.en: Control the complete outer group at the marked outer stand. Victory establishes only the same base access that the side-gate procedure can provide. It does not combine two route awards or change the current supply inspection. Keep the original tower control card: the actual left and right cooling valves, subsequent isolation and controlled maintenance unit still determine safety at the control level. Withdraw or retry with the same encounter identity and a new attempt; the current draft and source notes remain intact. A complete action that defeats both sides is failure, not an access receipt. No enemy here gives kill experience, currency or parts.
paragraphs.zh: 在外闸站位实际制止整组威胁。胜利只建立与侧闸同一塔基通行，不合并双路奖励或替换当前供给检查。仍保留原塔控制卡：控制层实际左右阀、之后隔离与维护机械制止共同决定安全。撤回/重试保留遭遇实例并新建尝试，正文与来源笔记仍在。同一完整动作双方皆倒为失败，不发通行。所有敌人零杀敌经验、刻币、零件。
